oneOf.description: Up-and-out: knocked out when spot touches or rises above the barrier.
Up-and-in: activated when spot touches or rises above the barrier.
Down-and-out: knocked out when spot touches or falls below the barrier.
Down-and-in: activated when spot touches or falls below the barrier.

attributes.description: Attributes for scenario selection and grouping

barrier.description: Barrier level (exchange rate that triggers knock-in/out, dimensionless)

base_currency.description: Base currency (the currency being priced, formerly foreign_currency)

day_count.description: Day count convention (defaults to ACT/365F, consistent with FxOption)

fx_spot_id.description:
Optional FX spot scalar identifier.

If omitted, pricing falls back to `FxMatrix(base_currency, quote_currency)`.

instrument_pricing_overrides.description:
Pricing overrides (manual price, yield, spread)
Instrument-owned pricing inputs.

monitoring.description:
Contractual barrier-monitoring convention.

Continuous monitoring uses the analytical Reiner-Rubinstein pricer by
default. Discrete monitoring requires explicit observation dates and
uses Monte Carlo without interpolating barrier hits between those dates.

monitoring_start_date.description:
First date on which barrier monitoring is active. When set, a live
valuation after this date requires `observed_barrier_breached`.

observed_barrier_breached.description:
Observed barrier state for expired options.

Historical monitoring must be supplied explicitly for expired contracts.

option_type.description: Option type (call or put on foreign currency)

quote_currency.description: Quote currency (the pricing/settlement currency, formerly domestic_currency)

rebate.description:
Optional rebate amount (paid if the barrier condition is met, dimensionless;
see `rebate_timing` for when a knock-out rebate pays)

rebate_timing.description:
Timing of the knock-out rebate payment.

`at_hit` (default, market standard) pays the rebate the moment a
knock-out barrier is breached; `at_expiry` defers payment to expiry.
Knock-in rebates always pay at expiry, so this setting does not affect
them. The analytical pricer values at-hit rebates via the discounted
first-passage closed form. Monte Carlo applies at-hit when
`rebate_timing == AtHit` via `with_rebate_at_hit`; the crate primitive
defaults to at-expiry.

strike.description: Strike exchange rate (quote per base, dimensionless)

InstrumentSchema.description: Canonical schema marker for persisted instrument envelopes.

oneOf.description: Monitor continuously through the contractual monitoring interval.
Monitor only at the stated contractual observation dates.

observation_dates.description: Strictly increasing dates on which the barrier level is observed.

OptionType.description: Option payoff direction used by analytical and numerical model engines.

RebateTiming.description:
Timing of a knock-out rebate payment.

Market-standard KO rebates pay **at hit** (the moment the barrier is
breached); paying at expiry is the less common variant. Knock-in rebates
always pay at expiry by definition (only at expiry is it known that the
option failed to knock in), so this setting does not affect them.

oneOf.description: Rebate is paid at the barrier hit time (market standard for KO rebates).
Rebate is paid at option expiry.
